fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami municipal affairs, including criticism of City Manager Wharton and discussion of Mayor/Commissioner Sewell and the Chamber of Commerce’s handling of city publicity funds. Coverage also addresses a campaign against drunken drivers, proposals and considerations for an airport site (including Biscayne Bay and Dinner Key), and Miami Beach coastal erosion and bond financing for oceanfront protection. Regular columns, local gossip items, letters to the editor, and notices appear alongside sports coverage featuring boxing bouts and other community events and advertisements.
